text.tspan: Evidence collection: what each source searches
Shared input: scoped service + safe labels • disjoint rings = 0–30→30–60→60–120→120–240 min • max items/bytes • profile revision
Window-sensitive connectors run concurrently until deterministic clarity or a bounded inconclusive outcome.
PagerDuty
GET /incidents/{pagerdutyId}
Exact incident lookup, not broad search.
Captures created time, current status,
severity and incident link.
Finding: incident state
Timeline: PagerDuty event
GitLab — per allowlisted project / branch / environment
• Merged MRs updated after window start; retain created + merged events
• Commits since/until; inspect diffs for up to 5 commits, only relevantPaths
• Parent + child pipelines updated within the window (paginated)
• Deployments filtered by configured environments and exact window
• Failed pipelines first; query failed current jobs, failed retry history,
then canceled jobs; collapse retry families and rank earliest hard failure
• Read bounded useful trace tails for selected failed job families
Produces change, pipeline, failed-step, deployment and code-reference evidence.
Nomad — only allowlisted namespace / job pairs
1. GET job state for every selected job before larger detail calls
2. GET allocations?all=true; retain non-running/non-complete allocations
3. GET deployments; flag non-successful state
4. GET evaluations; flag non-complete state
Requests include configured region + namespace. The Nomad token uses
X-Nomad-Token. Primary job state is protected from a noisy job exhausting
the shared byte budget.
Grafana
• Build dashboard and panel links for the exact time window
• GET annotations filtered by configured tags, from/to and item limit
• Render safe label templates into each configured datasource query
• POST /api/ds/query with 15s interval and max 240 data points
• Extract numeric values; compare maximum with warningAbove
Produces annotation timeline events and metric snapshot findings.
VictoriaLogs — scoped streams and configured LogSQL templates
1. Render safe label values into each expression.
2. Count every configured query first with /select/logsql/hits (60s step).
3. Only positive-count queries fetch samples with selected fields,
ascending _time order and a bounded limit (up to 20).
4. Deduplicate NDJSON lines, apply configured regex redaction,
preserve the first observed error as a timeline anchor.
Counting all streams first stops one noisy stream from starving later queries.
Shared connector boundary
• Per-source timeout (1–120s)
• Cumulative byte and item limits
• Stable IDs + provenance
• Relevance ranking before truncation
• Health: complete / partial / unavailable
MCP additionally validates source identity,
allowed resources and URLs; removes secrets,
deduplicates and fits retained output to 90%
of its byte budget.
